brief_title: A Study of CJC-1134-PC Injection in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes With Inadequately Controlled Blood Glucose Level After Metformin Monotherapy or Metformin in Combination With Insulin Secretagogues
official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase III Clinical Trial Designed to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CJC-1134-PC Injection Administered Once A Week in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes With Inadequately Controlled Blood Glucose Level After Metformin Monotherapy or Metformin in Combination With Insulin Secretagogues

lead_sponsor.name: Changshan ConjuChem BioPharmaceutical Research and Development (Hebei) Co., Ltd.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in HbA1c at the end of double-blind treatment period

brief_summary: This study is a Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase III Clinical Trial Designed to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CJC-1134-PC Injection Administered Once A Week in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes with Inadequately Controlled Blood Glucose Level after Metformin Monotherapy or Metformin in Combination with Insulin Secretagogues.
